summary: Iteration 17: Automated Evidence Collection feature and Documentation pages testing complete. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: Evidence collection from 5 sources (SIEM, pipeline, policies, assessments, checklists), artifacts list with expandable details, coverage analysis per framework, stats dashboard, collection run history. All 5 documentation HTML pages accessible and rendering correctly.

seed_data_creation: Evidence artifacts created via POST /api/evidence-collection/collect during testing. 22 artifacts collected from 5 sources.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 tested Automated Evidence Collection feature. Key endpoints: (1) POST /api/evidence-collection/collect - runs automated collection from 5 sources: siem_snapshot, pipeline_report, policy_document, compliance_assessment, checklist_mapping. Returns total collected, by_type breakdown, run_id. (2) GET /api/evidence-collection/artifacts - lists all artifacts with id, evidence_type, title, description, source, collected_at, control_ids, freshness. (3) GET /api/evidence-collection/artifacts/{id} - artifact detail. (4) DELETE /api/evidence-collection/artifacts/{id} - delete artifact. (5) GET /api/evidence-collection/coverage - per-framework coverage analysis with covered/uncovered/fresh/stale counts and coverage_pct. (6) GET /api/evidence-collection/stats - total_artifacts, by_type, fresh, stale, last_collection. (7) GET /api/evidence-collection/runs - collection run history. Frontend: Evidence Collection button on Frameworks page opens AutomatedEvidenceCollection component with 3 tabs (Overview/Artifacts/Coverage), stats cards, Run Collection button. Artifacts list shows expandable items with control IDs. Coverage tab shows per-framework coverage bars. Documentation: 5 HTML pages at /docs/*.html - marketing.html, security-architecture.html, ui-walkthrough.html, pitch-deck.html, brochure.html - all accessible (200 status) and rendering correctly.
